# Cursor AI Editor Optimization & Rules Engineering

Configure Cursor for deterministic agentic coding, context precision, and minimal hallucination.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Maintain an authoritative `.cursorrules` file in the project root detailing stack invariants and architectural guidelines.
- Tag relevant target files explicitly (`@file`) to prevent model hallucination and token churn.
- Review and verify multi-file diffs in Composer before executing automated applies.
- Enforce strict typing and test-driven cycles as non-negotiable prompt instructions.
